role: exposed development reference only; not clinical calibration or held-out validation
recordPerPatient: lowest ECG ID among eligible records
scarcityPolicy: retain actual N; no replacement with overlapping diagnoses and no automatic calibration eligibility
waveforms: original records500 only; WFDB16, 500 Hz, 5000 samples, 1000 counts/mV, zero offset
limitations: An isolated metadata label is not an independently adjudicated isolated disease.
NORM is a database ECG label, not proof of a healthy patient.
Likelihood 100 is a database annotation value, not certainty or diagnostic accuracy.
No future test-fold waveform is acquired by this protocol.
Sparse LPFB or WPW cohorts do not establish population amplitude ranges.
No demographic data or free-text clinical reports are exported.
